Save tokens, battery and CPU for overnight runs

When on, the assistant asks for shorter answers and gathers less background-research context, and background polling relaxes during quiet hours (00:00–06:00) when no task is running. Never disables a feature you started.
Assemble prompts from AGENTS.md and workspace context

When on, the coding agent reads AGENTS.md (or CLAUDE.md) from the active workspace as data and merges it into prompts; the assembled prompt is versioned. Off by default — when off, prompts are sent unchanged. AGENTS.md is always treated as data, never as system instructions.
